notes: Reward pictures that are not the kit's own icons, for the reward lines a letter, a delivery or a deal carries (Art.REWARD_ICON, Art.reward_icon). Each is cut clean on its own -- a reward tile's window shows round it -- and drawn down to the sizes a reward line uses (46 in a mail row, 52 in the Royal Delivery, 64 on the letter card).
Moved here from art/slices/mail.json: rewards/charter and rewards/energy_potion. Output unchanged.

reward_icons.png's sixteen (the brief's S8), cut for Wave 3's rewards: every one keyed off the sheet's flat navy (7,20,30, the ground varies by 5 at most) and drawn down to 120 on its long side, the size the store's lasting goods keep. The charter was already cut as rewards/charter. Token keys: flask_small, flask_large, pardon, cart (rewards/cart_token), boost:luck (rewards/fortune_charm) -- Art.REWARD_ICON.

crops.name: rewards/energy_potion
crops.note: The Energy Potion as a reward (key energy_potion): the blue flask the painting puts in the first row's third tile, lifted off the window's navy. Its liquid is held solid: the deepest blue is within the key of the navy and would otherwise let the ground through. The shop's icons/energy_potion is its card picture, glow and all, and reads as a lit rectangle in a reward tile.

crops.name: rewards/charter
crops.note: The Protection Charter token's icon (key city_shield): a charter with the shield seal, painted big on reward_icons.png and drawn down to the size a reward line uses.

crops.name: rewards/gem_red
crops.note: Gear not yet rolled (a reward line's icon item:<tier>): the tier's stone, the one every gear tile on the Family painting wears on its lower rim, cut round its gold setting so it sits in a reward tile on nothing -- the family crop (family/gem_red) keeps its slot's steel plate and the stubs of the rim. scripts/gen-gem-tints.py tints it to every tier (rewards/gem_<tier>, gem_empty) exactly as it tints the family stones.
